_about: The film layer's settings for this project (copy to <project>/film.json and keep only what you change; every key is optional). Turn on what the style file asks for (exec-dark: kicker, progress, plate, mask, vignette). Re-run scripts/film.py after changing this file. Scenes may pick another mask side, switch a part off or change plate class/drift in FL.setup(tl, opts); kicker and progress can only be switched on here.
